theme: Personal finance basics: emergency fund, 50/30/20 budgeting, good vs bad debt
headline: Build Financial Stability with Emergency Funds
body: Set aside 3-6 months of expenses. This safety net prevents debt during unexpected situations.
caption: An emergency fund protects you from life's surprises without derailing your goals. Starting small is better than waiting for the perfect amount. #EmergencyFund #PersonalFinance #FinancialStability #SmartMoney #MoneyTips
